text: えらばれた　もの　だけが　ここを　ぬけられるのだ！

structure.jp: えらばれた　もの　だけが

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: The れる ending here means the action is done to someone, not by them. えらばれた　もの = 'those who were chosen'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on this verb means 'can do'. ぬけられる = 'can get through'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes the statement sound like a firm explanation of how things are. ぬけられるのだ = 'the fact is, (only they) can get through'.
